registration.title: Odds history keeps only what is read, and a price only when it changes
registration.what: The odds capture keeps the match result, goals over/under at 1.5 to 4.5 and both teams to score, and stores a price only when it differs from the last one stored for that bookmaker and selection. Double chance and the other over/under lines are no longer kept.
registration.why: Odds were the database's fastest-growing table: about 790,000 rows a week. In a week's fixtures 49% of rows were over/under lines nothing reads, 10% double chance, which nothing reads, and 56% repeats of an unchanged price, stored again because the provider's update time is per fixture and moved with any price.
registration.how: config.ODDS_BET_IDS without 12 and config.ODDS_GOAL_LINES, applied in ingest._store_odds; record_odds compares the price (and kickoff, source) with the last observation, no longer the provider's update time. tests/test_odds_capture.py.
registration.hypothesis: Every reader's latest price at or before its cut-off is unchanged, so the paper bets, the market comparisons and every protocol see the same prices, while new odds rows fall by roughly 60 to 80%.
registration.success_criteria: Not a prediction change: the paper bets' decisions are unchanged. Checked by the odds rows added a week after release against about 790,000 a week before.

events.note: Reached main 2026-11-25; the next odds capture and the next run's paper-betting version use it.
